ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, and points C and D are on $\odot O$. If $\angle D=120^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle CAB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\angle D + \angle B = 180^\circ$ and $\angle D = 120^\circ$,

$\therefore \angle B = 60^\circ$,

Since $AB$ is the diameter,

$\therefore \angle ACB = 90^\circ$,

Hence, $\angle CAB = 90^\circ - \angle B = \boxed{30^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a cyclic quadrilateral A-D-C-B with A, B, C, D on the same circle, AB drawn as a diameter, and the requested angle at A in triangle ABC. From the text, use that ∠D = ∠ADC = 120° and AB is a diameter. Apply the cyclic quadrilateral rule that opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, so ∠ABC = 180° − 120° = 60°. Then apply Thales' theorem because AB is a diameter, giving ∠ACB = 90°. Finally use the angle sum in triangle ABC: ∠CAB = 180° − 90° − 60° = 30°.

先看图像：图中是一个圆，AB为水平直径，圆心O在AB上；A在左端，B在右端，D在左上方，C在右上方，A、D、C、B都在同一圆上，并且画出了弦AD、DC、CB和AC。题目给出的∠D对应图中的∠ADC，数值为120°。

由于A、D、C、B四点共圆，所以四边形ADCB是圆内接四边形，内接四边形的对角互补，因此
∠ABC = 180° - ∠ADC = 180° - 120° = 60°。

又因为AB是直径，所以由泰勒斯定理可知
∠ACB = 90°。

在三角形ABC中，三个内角和为180°，所以
∠CAB = 180° - ∠ABC - ∠ACB = 180° - 60° - 90° = 30°。

因此，∠CAB = 30°。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle with AB a diameter, C on the upper-right arc, D on the upper-left arc, and ∠D formed by chords DA and DC. From the text, ∠ADC = 120°. Use the inscribed-angle theorem: ∠ADC intercepts the arc AC not containing D, which in the figure is the arc going from A through B to C, so that intercepted arc has measure 2 × 120° = 240°. Since AB is a diameter, arc AB is a semicircle of 180°. Therefore the remaining arc BC on that intercepted arc is 240° − 180° = 60°. The desired angle ∠CAB is an inscribed angle intercepting arc CB, so ∠CAB = 1/2 × 60° = 30°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，AB 是经过圆心 O 的水平直径，A 在左侧，B 在右侧；C 位于圆的右上方，D 位于圆的左上方。图中连有 DA、DC、AC、CB、AB，因此 ∠D 可读作由 DA 和 DC 形成的 ∠ADC。

推理：已知 ∠ADC = 120°。根据圆周角定理，∠ADC 所对的是不含 D 的弧 AC；从图中看，这条弧是从 A 经过 B 再到 C 的弧，所以该弧 AC 的度数为 2 × 120° = 240°。因为 AB 是直径，所以弧 AB 是半圆，度数为 180°。因此弧 BC = 240° − 180° = 60°。所求 ∠CAB 是圆周角，它所对的弧是 CB，所以 ∠CAB = 1/2 × 60° = 30°。
